items.title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Bug Triggers Numerous False BIOS Alerts
items.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is currently experiencing a bug that generates false positive alerts concerning out-of-date Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) versions, primarily affecting Dell devices. The issue, tracked by Microsoft under the reference ID DZ1163521, is causing security teams to receive notifications to update device firmware that is already current. This has led to confusion […]…
